short: The Philippines has no AI act. The Senate of the 20th Congress lists eight AI bills, among them SBN-25, the Artificial Intelligence Regulation Act, pending in committee since 29 July 2025.
title: Philippines AI Laws
subtitle: No AI act; eight AI bills before the Senate of the 20th Congress
body_html:
Status at a glance

No AI act; bills pending. The Senate's own bill search lists eight AI bills in the 20th Congress. The broadest, SBN-25, the Artificial Intelligence Regulation Act (AIRA), filed by Senator Pia S. Cayetano, has been pending in committee since 29 July 2025. Verified on 13 November 2026 against senate.gov.ph; the status was checked only for SBN-25.

Key instruments

BillTitleFiled byFiled
SBN-25Artificial Intelligence Regulation Act (AIRA); pending in committee since 29 July 2025Pia S. Cayetano2 July 2025 per the Senate list; the bill page shows the as-filed copy dated 7 July 2025
SBN-79AI Training for Government Workforce ActEstrada3 July 2025
SBN-182Workers Protection and Skill Development in the Digital Economy ActC. Villar7 July 2025
SBN-782Physical Identity Protection ActEscudero4 August 2025
SBN-852AI Regulation Act, creating a Philippine Council on AIEstrada4 August 2025
SBN-1190AI Development and Regulation ActLapid14 August 2025
SBN-2097FAIR ActC. Villar5 May 2026
SBN-2563AI-related employment protectionE. Tulfo15 October 2026

Who regulates and enforces

No AI regulator exists while no AI act is in force. SBN-852 would create a Philippine Council on AI.

Penalties

Not yet verified. The Data Privacy Act's penalties have not been read on an official source, so no penalties table is given.

What is coming next

  • Committee action on SBN-25 and the other seven bills in the 20th Congress.

  • AI Policy Ledger, the law tracker

13 November 2026, against senate.gov.ph. The status was checked only for SBN-25; the other seven bills are listed as the Senate's search shows them. The Data Privacy Act's penalties are not yet read on an official source.
